content.title: Can machines think?
content.punchline: AI began as a question — not a product.
content.subtext: A bold idea: make intelligence mechanical.

content.title: The first conditions
content.subtext: The question became possible when machines could calculate.

content.title: A field is born
content.punchline: Speculation turned into a research discipline.
content.subtext: Artificial intelligence got a name, a scope, and a mission.

content.title: The first wall
content.subtext: Computing power and data were nowhere near enough.

content.title: AI winter
content.punchline: Optimism rose. Results lagged. Funding fell.
content.subtext: The same cycle repeated until the field froze.

content.title: A different path
content.subtext: Progress returned by chasing patterns, not hand-coded logic.

content.title: The real shift
content.punchline: AI learned from data instead of being told everything.
content.subtext: That changed what machines could do.

content.title: Modern AI stack
content.subtext: Enough of all three turns theory into working systems.

content.title: Everyday reach
content.punchline: Search. Recommendations. Translation. Medicine. Creative tools.
content.subtext: AI moved from lab concept to daily infrastructure.

content.title: The arc
content.subtext: That is the history of AI.
